whyBuy.title: Use Follower Growth to Reinforce an Active Canadian Facebook Page
whyBuy.description: Facebook Followers can support the visible audience size of a Page, but the Page should look current when someone arrives. Before adding followers, Canadian businesses and organisations can check that the Page name, category, About details, website, contact information and recent posts still match the real business. Treat the follower count as one part of the Page presentation and keep publishing useful updates that help visitors understand what the business offers, where it operates and what they should do next.
